scope_decisions.official_title: Stroke not known if ischaemic or haemorrhagic
scope_decisions.source: Frozen official WHO ICD11 MMS2026-01 text, exact code paragraph read
scope_decisions.scope: Established acute stroke meeting WHO criteria whose ischemic/hemorrhagic subtype remains undetermined. Broad symptom navigation does not itself establish this diagnosis. Not ischemic stroke or chronic sequelae.
scope_decisions.limitation: WHO duration criterion is a coding definition, never advice to delay emergency treatment; definitive subtype routes to dedicated article.

mece: Symptom entry and undetermined-type navigation preserved; 8B20 excluded from ischemic article leaf scope. Known hemorrhagic and ischemic subtypes each retain separate owned articles.
dispute_adjudication: No self-administered aspirin/anticoagulation while subtype unknown. Acute treatment selection deliberately has no generic home time cutoff. Rehabilitation support has no guarantee of full recovery.

structural_resolutions.resolution: No clinical text change. Removed unpublished SAH related link; mapped existing actual read version/population/independence metadata to formal support fields.
